owner_decisions: AM-0019 is additive after AM-0018; original.md and all non-conflicting prior requirements remain intact.
Plan readiness and engine enforcement are both mandatory; plan readiness is the source of intent and authority while engine owns tactics, scheduling, retry and recovery.
Main agent performs orchestration, artifact comparison, review supervision, reconciliation and terminal decision; it does not author product source or tests.
Depth-one native subagents are the primary execution mechanism; cross-host nested CLI and unapproved live session bridges are prohibited.
The scheduler maximizes useful conflict-free native concurrency across stages and uses isolated branch/worktree ownership with one integration owner.
Recoverable waiting blocks only the affected dependency closure and never ends the whole run.
Full deployed-topology verification and paired reference-target browser evidence are mandatory final convergence layers.
Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode are required Tier-A hosts; Grok is required functional; Antigravity is constrained/advisory; Cursor is deferred.
The engine may fast-forward certified local main, but it must keep all other branches/worktrees until owner review.
Remote main push and branch/worktree cleanup require a later explicit owner approval.
pos-ops and mini-toeic.score are evidence sources only and are not mutated by AM-0019.
All existing fitness criteria remain and M11-R11 through M11-R26 are additive.
Execution must dogfood accepted AM-0019 behavior immediately and continue to HV3_M11_LOCAL_COMPLETE without routine continuation questions.
